governance.note: The nyiso-40 corrected-gas config PLUS one structural mechanism: nyiso_import_hub_prices (transmission.inject_nyiso_import_hub_prices) - the priced import node's PJM_west / ISONE_tie tranches reprice at the MEASURED hourly PJM / ISO-NE Day-Ahead system LMP + the $1 inter-control-area wheeling hurdle (the same hurdle the PJM<->NYISO NeighborInterface spec carries), the residual import_scarcity block at the hourly max of the two (the deep non-firm MW cannot undercut every real adjacent market), and the export_surplus sink at the hourly min - hurdle (wash-free on a destination-blind single sink). This REPLACES the static per-year IMPORT_TRANCHES_BY_YEAR ladder, which the neighbor_price module documents as 'a backcast fit - re-fitted per year, blind to neighbor fundamentals'; the flat 2024 ladder (top $79.7) capped the modeled seam exactly when the real seam repriced with the neighbors (Dec-2024 NEISO $84.5/mo vs the $44.9 ISONE_tie constant; Jun-2025 heat-wave DA spikes). Exact analogue of the accepted miso_pjm_lmp_import_pricing (measured PJM border DA LMP) and caiso_import_hub_prices (measured WECC intertie LMP): a measured neighbor price-formation input (rule #12 - regenerates for a forward year from the modeled neighbor / reference-price formula and responds to changed conditions), read blind to NYISO's own flow (rule #11). HQ_hydro / IESO_Ontario keep their firm-contract ladder values (no organized-market LMP series; HQ is firm-floored). The monthly EIA-930 reconciliation band, HQ firm floor, SIL cap, offer curves, floors and outage overlay are unchanged from keeper 39. Also carries the nyiso-40 measured-gas fidelity fixes (true-dated Transco Z6 NY daily quotes; monthly hub levels recomputed from the completed daily series - Dec-2024 basis +0.16 -> +1.00). EFFECT: every price criterion moves toward actual with NO tuned constant - C3a -15.6/-19.2/-13.2 -> -13.3/-13.4/-9.5%, C3b NRMSE 0.211/0.304/0.203 -> 0.209/0.236/0.172, C3c 0h -> 7h (2025), the first NYISO model tail hours ever. C1/C2/C4 HARD gates PASS unchanged.

_open_items: The remaining price gap decomposes into two documented items: (1) DATA-BLOCKED eastern-NY winter hub level - the Iroquois Z2 monthly reconstruction (Transco monthly + SOM ANNUAL spread) under-reads constrained winter months (Dec-2024 ~$4.0/MMBtu vs the ~$9 New England complex the Z2 segment physically trades in; Jan/Feb-2025 likewise), worth roughly -$25 (Dec-24) / -$19//-$24 (Jan/Feb-25) monthly LMP. No free Iroquois Z2 series exists: NGI/ICE paywalled; the EIA NGWU compact table, printer-friendly table and narrative carry no Iroquois prints 2023-2025 (verified by the fetch-nyiso-gas-narrative workflow, incl. ngpf.asp probe). (2) The ledgered reserve-scarcity frontier (idle-capacity headroom credit; nyiso-29/31) for the RT scarcity adders and the >$300 tail.

exceptions.classification: ACCEPTED (marginal breach exposed by a kept measured input; root cause = ledgered steam under-run)
exceptions.reason: SOFT criterion -> CAVEAT. The model's 2024 CO2 was already low at the band edge because the in-city steam/CHP fleet under-runs (ST_GAS -1.4 TWh, the ledgered reserve-scarcity/min-gen frontier; ~-0.6 Mt at the steam fleet rate covers most of the -2.1 Mt gap). Correcting the Dec-2024 hub level (rule #13) shifted December burn off the dearer eastern units and moved the metric ~0.5pp across the band edge. The accurate input stays; the root cause is the same ledgered frontier.
